items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: But, where Jimmy Forrest is concerned, he's making a name for himself now, you know, and Eric Dixon has been tremendous, and as a whole, the whole thing is just about terrific as far as I'm concerned now.

ctx.x: There's no soloist of the stature of Lester Young, or---?

Well, no -- it's a different style altogether. And, the feeling is different as far as the playing is concerned. But, where Jimmy Forrest is concerned, he's making a name for himself now, you know, and Eric Dixon has been tremendous, and as a whole, the whole thing is just about terrific as far as I'm concerned now.

Do you think to some extent though, that Basie over the years has learned to be a little, perhaps, distrustful of prima donnas? That he might not want to have too many big stars (laugh) to give him a headache?
